proposal_title: Deletion of GenerationJob.track_mode from Canonical Domain Schema
domain_specific_rationale: From a Domain-Driven Design perspective, domain entities must encapsulate core business invariants and lifecycle state rather than low-level infrastructure dispatch mechanisms. The attribute track_mode represents an operational execution routing choice (such as browser extension worker versus headless Playwright worker versus API bridge). Embedding track_mode directly in the canonical GenerationJob entity leaked operational worker plumbing into the domain model. Formally deleting track_mode from domain-entities.schema.json and retaining operational dispatch routing within execution envelopes (e.g. FlowExecutionPort and ProviderRequest contracts) restores clean bounded context separation and purges infrastructure pollution from the domain core.
capability_impact: Directly preserves CAP-01 (Canonical Core State Management) by ensuring domain entity definitions remain strictly focused on business state and lineage without infrastructure dispatch contamination.
residual_risk: Workflow orchestrators or provider adapters expecting track_mode on the domain entity could experience deserialization mismatches if not updated. Mitigated by defining flow_track in operational execution contracts (flow-execution-result, provider-request) and updating R06 Workflow to pass routing options dynamically.
